contentHtml:
The main function of the kidney is the filtering of waste products from the blood and removal of excess water from the body.  If the kidney is not working properly, it may cause swelling all over the body, weakness, shortness of breath, abnormal heat rhythms, confusion etc…

We have effective treatment for kidney failure.  Our treatment helps in removing the body wastes dumped in the body including  swelling.  Creatine level will gradually comes down, there may be ups and downs in creatine level, on an average the creatine levels will gradually comes down. Gradually the patients condition will improve, and in one to three months time they will improve much.  Even if a patient is under dialysis, our treatment helps them a lot, initially the   time gap between  dialysis may increase, and finally it may helps in normalizing the kidney function.   Once it is normal there is no more need for dialysis of medication.  We have effective treatment for Diabetics and blood pressure too.  You can treat all together.

Our Kidney treatment consists of panchakarma plus internal and external medicines. Normally we admit the patients for 21 days, rare cases it may take more time.  Duration of the treatment depends upon how fast the patient is recovering.

Kidney, Gallbladder and Pancreatic Stone

Stone is a solid crystalline mineral material formed within the body.  Normally it appears in Kidney, Gallbladder, pancreas etc…   Certain foods like seafood’s, tomatoes, chocolates, Spinach, tea, salty foods, peanuts beetroots, etc…. may cause  Kidney stones, and it is better to avoid or minimize the use of these foods if you have stone again and again.   In case of Gallbladder stone it is better to avoid  fried foods and foods which are rich in fat. Calcium deposits in the pancreas may cause stones in the pancreas and gallstones sometimes moved to pancreas and blocks the movement of digestive  enzymes.  It is better to drink lemon juice, coconut water.  You have to drink at least 2 Liters of water every day.  Stone formed in the gallbladder is called gallbladder stone or gallstone or cholelith.  If the gallstone moves in to the common bile duct    it is called pancreatic stone.

We have effective treatment for  all types of stones.  Kidney stone normally takes one month to cure, Gall stone takes one to three months normally.  In case pancreatic stone it may take time, but the pain and further growth will stop in 1 to 4 weeks time.
